text:
{ "entries": [ { "name_han": "...", "logic_thesis": "...", "logic_chain": "...", "logic_practice": "...", "logic_compare": "..." } ] }{
  "entries": [
    {
      "name_han": "急救仙方",
      "logic_thesis": "Acute bodily crisis is not a random accident but a rupture in the continuum between form (形), qi, and spirit; therefore the same hierarchical logic that heals the immortal body can reverse mortal emergency if applied at the correct layer and tempo. The text proves that emergency medicine is truncated immortality technique: speed replaces gradual refinement because the path of reverse-flow (逆修) is structurally identical whether the goal is longevity or rescue.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: life is a layered system (精–氣–神) whose failure begins at a specific layer. 2) Inference: if the failing layer is identified, a corresponding agent or maneuver can re-couple the stack. 3) Inference: emergency formulas are therefore layer-targeted compressions of longer 服食/外丹 protocols. 4) Inference: timing and sequence matter more than dosage magnitude—wrong layer = false cure. 5) Conclusion: mastery of acute rescue demonstrates command of the same causal map used in cultivation, only with inverted priority (restore form first, then qi, then spirit).",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi crisis years (空亡、刑沖合會爆點), treat the chart like an acute case: stabilize the weakest useful 用神 before pursuing long-term structure. 2) Map sudden illness or accident to the failing layer (日主弱=形/精；印弱=氣耗；食傷暴發=神亂) and choose remedies that match layer, not symptom labels. 3) Keep a short-cycle “急救” protocol for 大運交接 and 流年衝擊: immediate environmental/lifestyle stopgap, then reconstruct long-term 格局. 4) Train reverse-order thinking: what would the immortal formula do slowly → compress it ethically into acute intervention.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike systematic classics such as 《黃帝內經》 which argue for seasonal prevention and full physiological systems, 《急救仙方》 argues from the edge-case of collapse. It differs from pure 外丹 manuals by refusing gradualism as a moral good; urgency itself becomes epistemic proof that the causal stack is real. Where alchemical texts prove transformation, this text proves reversibility under constraint."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "仙傳外科祕方",
      "logic_thesis": "The body-surface is not a passive boundary but an interface where internal pattern becomes visible and operable; therefore surgical and external methods are legitimate cosmological acts, not mere craft. The text proves that external form can be corrected without first perfecting internal alchemy, because the exterior already encodes the interior’s logic.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: lesions, wounds, and deformities are externalized phases of yin–yang imbalance. 2) Inference: what appears as “local” pathology is a node in a whole-body and seasonal field. 3) Inference: intervening at the surface can re-pattern the field if the agent respects the same five-phase and channel logic as internal medicine. 4) Inference: secrecy (祕方) protects not monopoly alone but the precision required so external force does not create secondary imbalance. 5) Conclusion: external therapy is applied metaphysics—form is a legitimate entrance to the Dao of the body.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Read BaZi “external” markers (傷官見官、偏印奪食、七殺無制) as surface expressions of deeper 格局 failure and treat the visible conflict first when it blocks all other work. 2) Use environmental and body-surface practices (sleep, posture, scar care, seasonal living) as legitimate 術, not inferior to meditation. 3) When 流年 brings 傷、破、刑 to body palace indicators, prioritize concrete physical repair over abstract 義理. 4) Preserve “secrecy” as precision discipline: do not broadcast raw techniques without mapping the person’s full chart context.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 《急救仙方》, which compresses time for systemic crisis, this text compresses space—working from boundary inward. Unlike pure 內丹 literature that distrusts form, it argues form is already a diagram of principle. It is closer to military craft than to philosophical quietism: the wound is a battlefield whose geometry must be read."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太清經斷穀法",
      "logic_thesis": "Grain is not merely food but a binding contract with the post-heaven cycle of growth–decay; therefore abstaining from grain is a logical unbinding from ordinary time, not a diet. The text proves that changing the fuel of the body changes the calendar the body runs on, making longevity a problem of metabolism as cosmology.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: ordinary grain carries the qi of seasonal ripening and thus of mortality’s clock. 2) Inference: continuous grain diet entrains the body to post-heaven 五行盛衰. 3) Inference: substituting refined qi-agents (氣、藥、符、水) can re-entrain the body to a slower or more primordial cycle. 4) Inference: abrupt cessation without substitution fails because emptiness of fuel is not yet presence of higher fuel. 5) Conclusion: 斷穀 works only as a replacement hierarchy, proving that “what you consume is the time you inhabit.”",
      "logic_practice": "1) In cultivation periods corresponding to strong 食傷 or 財 overdrive in BaZi, practice graded reduction of “grain-like” stimuli (over-information, over-consumption) rather than pure willpower fasting. 2) Map 斷穀 stages to chart readiness: weak 印/比劫 needs substitution first; strong 印 can attempt higher 服氣. 3) Treat 流年 驛馬、空亡 as windows for metabolic and schedule re-patterning. 4) Never read “stop eating” literally without the text’s logic of fuel replacement—apply the same to habits, not only food.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike single-herb 服食 tracts that prove one agent’s power, 《太清經斷穀法》 proves a structural substitution: the argument is about clocks and contracts, not ingredients. It differs from medical fasting by making cosmology primary and health secondary. Where 《神仙服食靈草菖蒲丸方傳》 specifies a positive substance, this text specifies a negative act that must be filled by a higher positive."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "神仙服食靈草菖蒲丸方傳",
      "logic_thesis": "A single plant, correctly timed, located, and prepared, can stand in for an entire alchemical furnace because it already concentrates water–spirit polarity; therefore the microcosm of gathering is the real work, not the pill alone. The text proves that method of selection (時、地、水向) is the true active ingredient.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: 菖蒲 is “water’s essence / immortal’s herb,” a natural concentrate of clear, upward, oracular qi. 2) Inference: only specimens grown under specified hydrological and calendrical conditions carry that concentrate. 3) Inference: wrong water direction or date yields ordinary plant, not 靈草. 4) Inference: preparation and pill-form are secondary encapsulation of a primary selection event. 5) Conclusion: efficacy is a proof of attunement to place–time–substance unity, not of chemistry in the modern sense.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, treat 用神 as “靈草”: the issue is not having many helpers but selecting the one that matches season, direction, and purity of context. 2) When choosing remedies (color, direction, career, partner), apply 菖蒲 logic: south-flowing / clear-stone conditions = environments that do not muddy the 用神. 3) Practice “gathering days” aligned with favorable 月令 and 日柱 rather than constant micro-optimization. 4) Use one refined practice deeply (one herb, one mantra, one sleep protocol) instead of polypharmacy of techniques.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 《太清經斷穀法》, which argues by subtraction from the grain-clock, this text argues by concentration of a positive natural agent. Unlike multi-formula 急救/外科 collections, it stakes the whole path on one substance’s correct capture. The difference is pedagogical: mono-focus teaches the law of selection more sharply than encyclopedias of recipes."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "素問入式運氣論奧",
      "logic_thesis": "Disease and weather are the same system read at two scales; therefore clinical judgment without 五運六氣 is incomplete logic. Liu Wenshu’s project proves that the obscure Suwen “great discussions” become usable once reduced to an entry schema (入式)—pattern recognition is not a dilution of mystery but the condition of applying it.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: heaven’s 五運 and 六氣 generate yearly and seasonal fields. 2) Inference: the same fields constrain host (主) and guest (客) qi, hence disease types. 3) Inference: without a didactic 入式, physicians cannot operationalize Suwen cosmology. 4) Inference: diagrams of 生成數、五音建運、標本 are cognitive tools that make prediction falsifiable year by year. 5) Conclusion: medical skill is applied astronomy of qi; pedagogy that clarifies is more faithful to the classic than opaque reverence.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Layer BaZi annual 流年 with classical 運氣 host/guest structures when judging epidemic-like career or health clusters. 2) Train “入式” discipline: before free interpretation of a chart, lock the formal skeleton (月令、格局、用忌、大運). 3) Use multi-scale reading: day–month–year–luck as 主客氣 analogues. 4) When two methods conflict, privilege the more constrained formal model first, then add experiential nuance—Liu’s method is anti-handwaving.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 《素問六氣玄珠密語》, which presents itself as oral secret expansion, 《入式運氣論奧》 proves the value of open didactic reduction. It differs from pure BaZi by remaining medical–meteorological rather than nativity-centered, yet supplies the shared premise that time is a pathogen and a remedy. Its logic is scholastic accessibility, not initiatory concealment."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "素問六氣玄珠密語",
      "logic_thesis": "The Suwen’s six-qi doctrine is not fully on the surface text; a parallel “dark pearl” transmission is required to unlock causal depth. The text proves that cosmology of 五運六氣 contains a esoteric stratum in which heavenly stems, earthly branches, and visceral dynamics form a closed secret algebra of prediction.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: public Suwen language is incomplete for full 運氣 mastery. 2) Inference: an oral/secret commentary tradition (玄珠子) preserves the missing operators. 3) Inference: once those operators are restored, disease, climate, and destiny become mutually convertible statements. 4) Inference: secrecy protects against misuse of high-resolution forecasting, not against understanding itself. 5) Conclusion: true medical astrology is a dual-text system—exoteric classic + esoteric key.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Treat standard BaZi formulas as “public Suwen” and keep a private checklist of edge operators (hidden stems, void, special combinations) as your 玄珠 layer. 2) When public rules fail a case, search for the missing operator rather than abandoning the system. 3) Practice controlled disclosure: teach beginners 入式 clarity; reserve dense multi-layer 六氣 analogues for advanced work. 4) Cross-read health years with both open 運氣 tables and personal chart secrets (弱點宮位).",
      "logic_compare": "It differs from Liu Wenshu’s 《入式運氣論奧》 by claiming initiatory depth rather than pedagogical transparency: same domain, opposite epistemology of access. Unlike spirit-lot texts that externalize answer-giving to deities, it keeps authority inside a technical secret tradition. The comparison key is not content (both are 運氣) but the proof strategy: open schema vs. dark key."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "祕藏通玄變化六陰洞微遁甲真經",
      "logic_thesis": "Space–time is a lock whose combination is 六陰/遁甲 patterning; therefore strategic action succeeds when it moves through the open gate of the moment, not when it overpowers circumstance. The text proves that “change” (變化) is lawful: concealment, timing, and directional selection are applications of one hidden arithmetic of heaven.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: heaven hides configurations (遁) that alternate open and closed pathways. 2) Inference: human affairs succeed by aligning with open pathways (門、局、陰遁/陽遁). 3) Inference: six-yin subtle patterns encode micro-adjustments beyond coarse calendrics. 4) Inference: true martial/ritual skill is cryptographic—reading the lock—not mere force. 5) Conclusion: agency is maximized by intelligent disappearance into correct timing, proving 通玄 as operational, not mystical fog.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi decision work, treat 空亡、合絆、刑沖 as 遁甲-style locks: sometimes the move is wait/hide, not push. 2) Map career and travel choices to “open gates” of 大運 (supportive 印比 vs. locked 財官). 3) Practice micro-timing: choose dates that match the chart’s active 用神 direction rather than generic auspicious lists. 4) Use 六陰洞微 thinking for negotiation: reduce visibility when 七殺 is wild; advance when 食傷制殺 is online.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 運氣 medical texts that describe climate–body causality, 遁甲 proves action-geometry: how to move inside the field. Unlike 靈籤 texts that outsource the answer to lots, this classic keeps computation with the operator. It is closer to strategy science than devotion; its “secret store” is an algorithm of concealment and emergence."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "法師選擇記",
      "logic_thesis": "Ritual efficacy is conditional on calendrical and directional selection; therefore a priest’s power is not charisma alone but correct insertion of rite into the cosmic schedule. The text proves that liturgy is a timed technology: wrong day/hour collapses the same words into noise.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: rites address specific deities, directions, and qi phases. 2) Inference: those addressees are available or obstructed by selection rules (選擇). 3) Inference: recording and standardizing selection criteria turns private skill into transmissable method. 4) Inference: failure of ritual is often mis-timing misread as weak faith. 5) Conclusion: 法師 authority rests on applied hemerology—selection is half the sacrament.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Never cast major BaZi remedies (relocation, marriage, business start) without dual check: chart 用神 + traditional 選擇 constraints. 2) Build a personal “法師記”: log which date types worked for which chart structures. 3) Treat 流年 太歲 clashes as closed gates for certain rites (confrontational launches). 4) When counseling clients, separate message content from timing: a true strategy on a wrong day is still a false operation.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with 遁甲’s full strategic cryptography, 《法師選擇記》 is narrower: it proves liturgical calendrics rather than battlefield movement. Unlike 靈籤 corpora that answer “what will happen,” it answers “when may we act.” It differs from pure astronomical 運氣 by being procedural and clerical—practice notes, not cosmology treatise."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "四聖真君靈籤",
      "logic_thesis": "Moral and situational uncertainty can be resolved by a constrained random draw under saintly warrant because the lot system externalizes pattern recognition the anxious mind cannot perform. The text proves that divination is a logic of authorized contingency: chance becomes signal when nested in a ethical–ritual frame.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: human deliberation is biased under desire and fear. 2) Inference: a numbered lot + verse shifts cognition from rumination to interpretation. 3) Inference: “四聖” authority stabilizes trust so the querent actually acts on the reading. 4) Inference: verses encode recurrent life topologies (gain, loss, wait, repent) rather than unique prophecies. 5) Conclusion: the system proves practical wisdom via patterned randomness, not omniscience.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Use lot-logic as a BaZi teaching aid: map 籤意 to chart structures (e.g., wait-lots when 用神在庫未開). 2) When client overthinks, introduce a constrained decision ritual before re-reading the chart. 3) Train interpretation of symbolic verse as training for reading 意象 in pillars. 4) Keep ethics first: lots that demand repentance map to 傷官見官 / 殺印相生 repair paths.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike technical 遁甲/運氣 texts that claim calculative necessity, 靈籤 proves the usefulness of sacred chance. Among lot texts, 《四聖真君靈籤》 is general multi-domain guidance under a shared “four saints” warrant, not specialized fertility or state-protection cults. Its distinct logic is broad ethical topology rather than niche patronage."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "上清元始高上玉皇九天譜錄",
      "logic_thesis": "Spiritual rank is not a metaphor but a register (譜錄) in a celestial bureaucracy; therefore salvation and authority depend on correct inscription and recognition in the hierarchy of 九天. The text proves that identity in the Daoist cosmos is documentary: to be known on the register is to have ontological standing.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Shangqing cosmology orders heavens, deities, and adepts in graded rolls. 2) Inference: ritual names, talismans, and lineages are enrollment technologies. 3) Inference: without 譜錄 alignment, personal cultivation lacks jurisdictional power. 4) Inference: the Jade Emperor / Primordial system is a constitution, not a poem. 5) Conclusion: hierarchy is the logic of efficacy—rank mediates what qi one may legally command.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi terms, treat 格局 and 调候 as “register status”: raw day-master strength is not rank until structured. 2) Cultivate through legitimate sequences (lineage, precepts, progressive practices) rather than scavenging techniques without enrollment logic. 3) Read 貴人、印星 as register-protectors; 空亡 on useful gods as missing paperwork. 4) For destiny work, clarify role identity (who you are authorized to be this 大運) before stacking methods.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike medical and lot texts, this is constitutional theology: it proves bureaucracy of heaven. Compared with 齋儀 texts that stage timebound rites, 譜錄 fixes permanent status. Compared with philosophical 文始/通玄 commentaries that dissolve name and rank into Dao, this text insists names and ranks are operationally real within the religious system."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "洞玄靈寶八節齋宿啟儀",
      "logic_thesis": "Cosmic joints (八節) are when heaven’s gates are procedurally open; therefore communal fasting and overnight preparatory liturgy (齋宿啟) can re-synchronize the human community with those gates. The text proves that calendar festivals are not commemorations but access protocols.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: the year has eight structural nodes of qi turn. 2) Inference: Lingbao zhai at those nodes multiplies efficacy through collective purity and correct sequence. 3) Inference: 宿啟 (night preparation/opening) is necessary because abrupt rite lacks accumulated stillness. 4) Inference: instrument, word, and time form a single machine. 5) Conclusion: salvation/communal blessing is scheduled engineering of purity at seasonal hinges.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Align personal cultivation intensives with 八節 and with BaZi 月令 transitions, not only with crises. 2) Practice “齋宿”: night-before preparation (sleep, diet, intention) before major decisions or rites. 3) Use group accountability (community zhai logic) when individual willpower fails in long 大運 repairs. 4) Map the eight nodes onto chart review cadence: structured re-synchronization eight times a year.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike private 服食 or 斷穀, this is collective and liturgical. Unlike 法師選擇記’s general hemerology, it fixes a specific Lingbao eight-joint template. Unlike 譜錄’s permanent ranks, it proves temporary, cyclical access. The argument is about synchronized opening, not personal hierarchy or secret calculation."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "玄真靈應寶籤",
      "logic_thesis": "True response (靈應) is not arbitrary miracle but a lawful feedback when sincerity meets a codified lot corpus; therefore the “mystery-true” oracle proves that heaven answers in the language humans prepare. The text argues that responsiveness is co-authored by ritual form and querent integrity.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: unstructured prayer yields ambiguous outcomes. 2) Inference: a 寶籤 system pre-structures heaven’s reply into interpretable units. 3) Inference: 玄真 names the condition of non-counterfeit response—form without sincerity is empty, sincerity without form is mute. 4) Inference: repeated communal use calibrates the corpus’s practical reliability. 5) Conclusion: oracle efficacy proves a contract model of divine–human communication.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi counseling, pair chart facts with a sincerity check: clients who will not act convert any oracle into noise. 2) Prefer structured question forms (one issue, one horizon) analogous to single-lot draws. 3) Track “靈應” empirically: which advice types correlate with later outcomes for which 格局. 4) Use verse imagery to unlock emotional blocks that pure stem-branch talk cannot reach.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with named cult lots (聖母、洪恩、江東王), 《玄真靈應寶籤》 foregrounds the abstract principle of authentic response rather than a specialized protector’s portfolio. It differs from 四聖 by emphasizing 靈應 epistemology (how answerhood works) more than multi-saint patronage. Less bureaucratic than 譜錄, more theological than pure 選擇 notes."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "大慈好生九天衛房聖母元君靈應寶籤",
      "logic_thesis": "Birth, gestation, and the protection of life-gate (衛房) are under a specialized maternal jurisdiction in the nine heavens; therefore petitions about fertility, delivery, and child fate require a distinct oracle logic of compassion-for-life (好生). The text proves that not all lots are generic: domain-specific deities encode domain-specific causal priorities.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: human generation is cosmically vulnerable at the birth chamber. 2) Inference: 衛房聖母 specializes in that vulnerability. 3) Inference: lots under her warrant prioritize life-preservation ethics over career or war logics. 4) Inference: 好生 is not sentiment but a selection rule among possible outcomes. 5) Conclusion: specialized 靈籤 prove functional differentiation in the pantheon—jurisdiction determines judgment style.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, isolate 子女宮、時柱、印星、傷官 as “衛房” subsystem; do not judge them with pure wealth logic. 2) For fertility/child questions, weight compassion-preserving options (timing, medical care, rest) as first-order 用神 work. 3) When 七殺 or 羊刃 threatens body/children indicators, apply 好生 hierarchy: stabilize life before optimizing prestige. 4) Use maternal-deity logic to counsel without fatalism—protection is procedural, not guaranteed magic.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike general 四聖 or 玄真 lots, this corpus is domain-locked to natal protection. It differs from state-protection lots (護國、江東王) by private/family biopolitics rather than polity. Compared with medical 急救 texts, it externalizes protection to a celestial midwifery office rather than human emergency craft—same aim (life), different agent of proof."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "洪恩靈濟真君靈籤",
      "logic_thesis": "Grace (洪恩) and efficacious rescue (靈濟) operate as a credit of past merit and present petition under the True Lords’ warrant; therefore misfortune is often framed as solvable debt rather than fixed doom. The text proves a soteriology of responsive aid: the lot system teaches how to re-enter a field of grace.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: the 靈濟真君 cult centers vast kindness and practical succor. 2) Inference: lots under this frame bias toward repentance, offering, and reopened paths. 3) Inference: reading misfortune as “blocked grace” changes agency from despair to repair. 4) Inference: standardized verses distribute that theology to ordinary querents. 5) Conclusion: the oracle proves pastoral logic—heaven’s help is structured as reclaimable relation.",
      "logic_practice": "1) When BaZi shows heavy 凶 but surviving 印/貴人, counsel “reclaim grace” strategies (repair relationships, clear obligations) over pure struggle. 2) Map 洪恩 to cumulative merit: consistent small correct actions in a hard 大運. 3) Use this lot’s mood for clients in shame-spirals: reframe as recoverable jurisdiction. 4) Pair chart 解災 with concrete restitution acts—grace logic hates empty performance.",
      "logic_compare": "Distinct from 聖母’s natal specialty and from martial/state lots, 洪恩靈濟 emphasizes broad merciful rescue. Compared with 玄真’s abstract response theory, it personalizes response as “vast kindness.” Philosophically softer than 遁甲’s hard locks, it proves relational unlocking: not all closed gates are cryptographic—some are moral-relational."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "扶天廣聖如意靈籤",
      "logic_thesis": "“As-you-wish” (如意) under heaven-supporting sagehood is not unlimited desire fulfillment but alignment such that upright will and heavenly order coincide. The text proves that true wish-logic is rectification: when the wish is made compliant with 扶天, outcomes feel effortless because resistance was definitional, not external only.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: scattered desire collides with heaven’s order. 2) Inference: 廣聖 warrant disciplines wishes into supportable aims. 3) Inference: lots train the querent to detect which wishes are 扶天 and which are private inflation. 4) Inference: “如意” marks the coincidence event, not a vending machine. 5) Conclusion: oracle pedagogy is will-calibration under cosmic loyalty.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi goal-setting, filter aims through 格局: only wishes that the chart can “扶” without self-destruction count as 如意 candidates. 2) When 食傷 is strong, refine expression; when 財 is strong but 官印 broken, curb pure acquisition wishes. 3) Use lot-style questions: “Which of these two aims is heaven-supporting for this 大運?” 4) Measure success as reduced friction after alignment, not as raw intensity of craving satisfied.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 洪恩’s mercy-for-suffering emphasis, 扶天廣聖如意 stresses righteous wish alignment. Unlike 護國嘉濟’s territorial protection, it is more about personal will under cosmic loyalty. It sits between philosophy (will vs. Dao) and folk oracle, proving a middle thesis: desire is educable by sacred form."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "護國嘉濟江東王靈籤",
      "logic_thesis": "Local tutelary sovereignty (江東王) links personal fortune to the health of a protected realm; therefore private lots under a state-guardian prove that micro-fate is nested in macro-political-spatial order. The text argues that “嘉濟” (excellent aid) flows through a territorial cult logic, not only through abstract heaven.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: regional deities govern and rescue within a jurisdiction. 2) Inference: petitions and lots under 江東王 inherit that territorial charter. 3) Inference: personal crises are readable as disturbances inside a larger protected order. 4) Inference: loyalty, offerings, and civic virtue modulate access to aid. 5) Conclusion: destiny is partly geopolitical-spiritual: place-based warrant differs from universal abstract Dao.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, weight 長生方向、驛馬、地理風水 as jurisdictional factors—not all remedies are portable across place. 2) For relocation advice, ask which “realm” will protect this day-master (cult logic → city/field choice). 3) Read 歲運 clashes with national/regional unrest years as 護國-layer context for individual charts. 4) Practice gratitude to place: stable base is a 貴人 often ignored by pure pillar math.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 九天聖母’s birth chamber or 四聖’s general ethics, this is territorial. Unlike Shangqing 譜錄’s celestial bureaucracy, the warrant is regional kingship. Compared with 遁甲’s abstract gates, 江東王 lots personalize space as a named protector. The unique proof is nested scale: person ⊂ realm ⊂ heaven."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "文始真經注",
      "logic_thesis": "If Dao were merely something of which we cannot speak, speech and Dao would be two; Guanyinzi’s formula “不可言即道” proves their non-duality—unspeakability is not a property attached to a mute object but the mode in which Dao is present. The commentary proves that linguistic failure is itself a positive revelation of unity, not a mere limit of humans.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: ordinary reading of Laozi makes “constant Dao” an unreachable other. 2) Inference: Guanyinzi flips: there is not a Dao that happens to be unspeakable; the unspeakable is Dao. 3) Inference: likewise for unthinkability—thought’s limit is not outside Dao. 4) Inference: tian/ming/shen/xuan are provisional names for one non-manipulable reality. 5) Conclusion: cultivation by forced speech-concepts self-defeats; release into the non-dual mode is the argument’s practical entailment.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi study, refuse idolatry of labels: 格局 names are tools, not the living chart—practice “unspeakable reading” after formal analysis. 2) When clients cling to fatal sentences (“I am 傷官架殺”), use 文始 logic to reopen non-dual agency. 3) Alternate technical drill with silent observation of timing as lived. 4) Treat 用神 selection as pointing, not capturing—like naming that must cancel itself.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike 靈籤 corpora that multiply words as divine answers, 文始 notes prove the insufficiency and yet non-duality of words. entries.logic_thesis: Acute bodily crisis is not a random accident but a rupture in the continuum between form (形), qi, and spirit; therefore the same hierarchical logic that heals the immortal body can reverse mortal emergency if applied at the correct layer and tempo. The text proves that emergency medicine is truncated immortality technique: speed replaces gradual refinement because the path of reverse-flow (逆修) is structurally identical whether the goal is longevity or rescue.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: life is a layered system (精–氣–神) whose failure begins at a specific layer. 2) Inference: if the failing layer is identified, a corresponding agent or maneuver can re-couple the stack. 3) Inference: emergency formulas are therefore layer-targeted compressions of longer 服食/外丹 protocols. 4) Inference: timing and sequence matter more than dosage magnitude—wrong layer = false cure. 5) Conclusion: mastery of acute rescue demonstrates command of the same causal map used in cultivation, only with inverted priority (restore form first, then qi, then spirit).
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi crisis years (空亡、刑沖合會爆點), treat the chart like an acute case: stabilize the weakest useful 用神 before pursuing long-term structure. 2) Map sudden illness or accident to the failing layer (日主弱=形/精；印弱=氣耗；食傷暴發=神亂) and choose remedies that match layer, not symptom labels. 3) Keep a short-cycle “急救” protocol for 大運交接 and 流年衝擊: immediate environmental/lifestyle stopgap, then reconstruct long-term 格局. 4) Train reverse-order thinking: what would the immortal formula do slowly → compress it ethically into acute intervention.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike systematic classics such as 《黃帝內經》 which argue for seasonal prevention and full physiological systems, 《急救仙方》 argues from the edge-case of collapse. It differs from pure 外丹 manuals by refusing gradualism as a moral good; urgency itself becomes epistemic proof that the causal stack is real. Where alchemical texts prove transformation, this text proves reversibility under constraint.

entries.logic_thesis: The body-surface is not a passive boundary but an interface where internal pattern becomes visible and operable; therefore surgical and external methods are legitimate cosmological acts, not mere craft. The text proves that external form can be corrected without first perfecting internal alchemy, because the exterior already encodes the interior’s logic.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: lesions, wounds, and deformities are externalized phases of yin–yang imbalance. 2) Inference: what appears as “local” pathology is a node in a whole-body and seasonal field. 3) Inference: intervening at the surface can re-pattern the field if the agent respects the same five-phase and channel logic as internal medicine. 4) Inference: secrecy (祕方) protects not monopoly alone but the precision required so external force does not create secondary imbalance. 5) Conclusion: external therapy is applied metaphysics—form is a legitimate entrance to the Dao of the body.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read BaZi “external” markers (傷官見官、偏印奪食、七殺無制) as surface expressions of deeper 格局 failure and treat the visible conflict first when it blocks all other work. 2) Use environmental and body-surface practices (sleep, posture, scar care, seasonal living) as legitimate 術, not inferior to meditation. 3) When 流年 brings 傷、破、刑 to body palace indicators, prioritize concrete physical repair over abstract 義理. 4) Preserve “secrecy” as precision discipline: do not broadcast raw techniques without mapping the person’s full chart context.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 《急救仙方》, which compresses time for systemic crisis, this text compresses space—working from boundary inward. Unlike pure 內丹 literature that distrusts form, it argues form is already a diagram of principle. It is closer to military craft than to philosophical quietism: the wound is a battlefield whose geometry must be read.

entries.logic_thesis: Grain is not merely food but a binding contract with the post-heaven cycle of growth–decay; therefore abstaining from grain is a logical unbinding from ordinary time, not a diet. The text proves that changing the fuel of the body changes the calendar the body runs on, making longevity a problem of metabolism as cosmology.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: ordinary grain carries the qi of seasonal ripening and thus of mortality’s clock. 2) Inference: continuous grain diet entrains the body to post-heaven 五行盛衰. 3) Inference: substituting refined qi-agents (氣、藥、符、水) can re-entrain the body to a slower or more primordial cycle. 4) Inference: abrupt cessation without substitution fails because emptiness of fuel is not yet presence of higher fuel. 5) Conclusion: 斷穀 works only as a replacement hierarchy, proving that “what you consume is the time you inhabit.”
entries.logic_practice: 1) In cultivation periods corresponding to strong 食傷 or 財 overdrive in BaZi, practice graded reduction of “grain-like” stimuli (over-information, over-consumption) rather than pure willpower fasting. 2) Map 斷穀 stages to chart readiness: weak 印/比劫 needs substitution first; strong 印 can attempt higher 服氣. 3) Treat 流年 驛馬、空亡 as windows for metabolic and schedule re-patterning. 4) Never read “stop eating” literally without the text’s logic of fuel replacement—apply the same to habits, not only food.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-herb 服食 tracts that prove one agent’s power, 《太清經斷穀法》 proves a structural substitution: the argument is about clocks and contracts, not ingredients. It differs from medical fasting by making cosmology primary and health secondary. Where 《神仙服食靈草菖蒲丸方傳》 specifies a positive substance, this text specifies a negative act that must be filled by a higher positive.

entries.name_han: 神仙服食靈草菖蒲丸方傳
entries.logic_thesis: A single plant, correctly timed, located, and prepared, can stand in for an entire alchemical furnace because it already concentrates water–spirit polarity; therefore the microcosm of gathering is the real work, not the pill alone. The text proves that method of selection (時、地、水向) is the true active ingredient.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: 菖蒲 is “water’s essence / immortal’s herb,” a natural concentrate of clear, upward, oracular qi. 2) Inference: only specimens grown under specified hydrological and calendrical conditions carry that concentrate. 3) Inference: wrong water direction or date yields ordinary plant, not 靈草. 4) Inference: preparation and pill-form are secondary encapsulation of a primary selection event. 5) Conclusion: efficacy is a proof of attunement to place–time–substance unity, not of chemistry in the modern sense.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, treat 用神 as “靈草”: the issue is not having many helpers but selecting the one that matches season, direction, and purity of context. 2) When choosing remedies (color, direction, career, partner), apply 菖蒲 logic: south-flowing / clear-stone conditions = environments that do not muddy the 用神. 3) Practice “gathering days” aligned with favorable 月令 and 日柱 rather than constant micro-optimization. 4) Use one refined practice deeply (one herb, one mantra, one sleep protocol) instead of polypharmacy of techniques.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 《太清經斷穀法》, which argues by subtraction from the grain-clock, this text argues by concentration of a positive natural agent. Unlike multi-formula 急救/外科 collections, it stakes the whole path on one substance’s correct capture. The difference is pedagogical: mono-focus teaches the law of selection more sharply than encyclopedias of recipes.

entries.logic_thesis: Disease and weather are the same system read at two scales; therefore clinical judgment without 五運六氣 is incomplete logic. Liu Wenshu’s project proves that the obscure Suwen “great discussions” become usable once reduced to an entry schema (入式)—pattern recognition is not a dilution of mystery but the condition of applying it.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: heaven’s 五運 and 六氣 generate yearly and seasonal fields. 2) Inference: the same fields constrain host (主) and guest (客) qi, hence disease types. 3) Inference: without a didactic 入式, physicians cannot operationalize Suwen cosmology. 4) Inference: diagrams of 生成數、五音建運、標本 are cognitive tools that make prediction falsifiable year by year. 5) Conclusion: medical skill is applied astronomy of qi; pedagogy that clarifies is more faithful to the classic than opaque reverence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Layer BaZi annual 流年 with classical 運氣 host/guest structures when judging epidemic-like career or health clusters. 2) Train “入式” discipline: before free interpretation of a chart, lock the formal skeleton (月令、格局、用忌、大運). 3) Use multi-scale reading: day–month–year–luck as 主客氣 analogues. 4) When two methods conflict, privilege the more constrained formal model first, then add experiential nuance—Liu’s method is anti-handwaving.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 《素問六氣玄珠密語》, which presents itself as oral secret expansion, 《入式運氣論奧》 proves the value of open didactic reduction. It differs from pure BaZi by remaining medical–meteorological rather than nativity-centered, yet supplies the shared premise that time is a pathogen and a remedy. Its logic is scholastic accessibility, not initiatory concealment.

entries.logic_thesis: The Suwen’s six-qi doctrine is not fully on the surface text; a parallel “dark pearl” transmission is required to unlock causal depth. The text proves that cosmology of 五運六氣 contains a esoteric stratum in which heavenly stems, earthly branches, and visceral dynamics form a closed secret algebra of prediction.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: public Suwen language is incomplete for full 運氣 mastery. 2) Inference: an oral/secret commentary tradition (玄珠子) preserves the missing operators. 3) Inference: once those operators are restored, disease, climate, and destiny become mutually convertible statements. 4) Inference: secrecy protects against misuse of high-resolution forecasting, not against understanding itself. 5) Conclusion: true medical astrology is a dual-text system—exoteric classic + esoteric key.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat standard BaZi formulas as “public Suwen” and keep a private checklist of edge operators (hidden stems, void, special combinations) as your 玄珠 layer. 2) When public rules fail a case, search for the missing operator rather than abandoning the system. 3) Practice controlled disclosure: teach beginners 入式 clarity; reserve dense multi-layer 六氣 analogues for advanced work. 4) Cross-read health years with both open 運氣 tables and personal chart secrets (弱點宮位).
entries.logic_compare: It differs from Liu Wenshu’s 《入式運氣論奧》 by claiming initiatory depth rather than pedagogical transparency: same domain, opposite epistemology of access. Unlike spirit-lot texts that externalize answer-giving to deities, it keeps authority inside a technical secret tradition. The comparison key is not content (both are 運氣) but the proof strategy: open schema vs. dark key.

entries.name_han: 祕藏通玄變化六陰洞微遁甲真經
entries.logic_thesis: Space–time is a lock whose combination is 六陰/遁甲 patterning; therefore strategic action succeeds when it moves through the open gate of the moment, not when it overpowers circumstance. The text proves that “change” (變化) is lawful: concealment, timing, and directional selection are applications of one hidden arithmetic of heaven.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: heaven hides configurations (遁) that alternate open and closed pathways. 2) Inference: human affairs succeed by aligning with open pathways (門、局、陰遁/陽遁). 3) Inference: six-yin subtle patterns encode micro-adjustments beyond coarse calendrics. 4) Inference: true martial/ritual skill is cryptographic—reading the lock—not mere force. 5) Conclusion: agency is maximized by intelligent disappearance into correct timing, proving 通玄 as operational, not mystical fog.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi decision work, treat 空亡、合絆、刑沖 as 遁甲-style locks: sometimes the move is wait/hide, not push. 2) Map career and travel choices to “open gates” of 大運 (supportive 印比 vs. locked 財官). 3) Practice micro-timing: choose dates that match the chart’s active 用神 direction rather than generic auspicious lists. 4) Use 六陰洞微 thinking for negotiation: reduce visibility when 七殺 is wild; advance when 食傷制殺 is online.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 運氣 medical texts that describe climate–body causality, 遁甲 proves action-geometry: how to move inside the field. Unlike 靈籤 texts that outsource the answer to lots, this classic keeps computation with the operator. It is closer to strategy science than devotion; its “secret store” is an algorithm of concealment and emergence.

entries.logic_thesis: Ritual efficacy is conditional on calendrical and directional selection; therefore a priest’s power is not charisma alone but correct insertion of rite into the cosmic schedule. The text proves that liturgy is a timed technology: wrong day/hour collapses the same words into noise.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: rites address specific deities, directions, and qi phases. 2) Inference: those addressees are available or obstructed by selection rules (選擇). 3) Inference: recording and standardizing selection criteria turns private skill into transmissable method. 4) Inference: failure of ritual is often mis-timing misread as weak faith. 5) Conclusion: 法師 authority rests on applied hemerology—selection is half the sacrament.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Never cast major BaZi remedies (relocation, marriage, business start) without dual check: chart 用神 + traditional 選擇 constraints. 2) Build a personal “法師記”: log which date types worked for which chart structures. 3) Treat 流年 太歲 clashes as closed gates for certain rites (confrontational launches). 4) When counseling clients, separate message content from timing: a true strategy on a wrong day is still a false operation.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 遁甲’s full strategic cryptography, 《法師選擇記》 is narrower: it proves liturgical calendrics rather than battlefield movement. Unlike 靈籤 corpora that answer “what will happen,” it answers “when may we act.” It differs from pure astronomical 運氣 by being procedural and clerical—practice notes, not cosmology treatise.

entries.logic_thesis: Moral and situational uncertainty can be resolved by a constrained random draw under saintly warrant because the lot system externalizes pattern recognition the anxious mind cannot perform. The text proves that divination is a logic of authorized contingency: chance becomes signal when nested in a ethical–ritual frame.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: human deliberation is biased under desire and fear. 2) Inference: a numbered lot + verse shifts cognition from rumination to interpretation. 3) Inference: “四聖” authority stabilizes trust so the querent actually acts on the reading. 4) Inference: verses encode recurrent life topologies (gain, loss, wait, repent) rather than unique prophecies. 5) Conclusion: the system proves practical wisdom via patterned randomness, not omniscience.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use lot-logic as a BaZi teaching aid: map 籤意 to chart structures (e.g., wait-lots when 用神在庫未開). 2) When client overthinks, introduce a constrained decision ritual before re-reading the chart. 3) Train interpretation of symbolic verse as training for reading 意象 in pillars. 4) Keep ethics first: lots that demand repentance map to 傷官見官 / 殺印相生 repair paths.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike technical 遁甲/運氣 texts that claim calculative necessity, 靈籤 proves the usefulness of sacred chance. Among lot texts, 《四聖真君靈籤》 is general multi-domain guidance under a shared “four saints” warrant, not specialized fertility or state-protection cults. Its distinct logic is broad ethical topology rather than niche patronage.

entries.name_han: 上清元始高上玉皇九天譜錄
entries.logic_thesis: Spiritual rank is not a metaphor but a register (譜錄) in a celestial bureaucracy; therefore salvation and authority depend on correct inscription and recognition in the hierarchy of 九天. The text proves that identity in the Daoist cosmos is documentary: to be known on the register is to have ontological standing.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Shangqing cosmology orders heavens, deities, and adepts in graded rolls. 2) Inference: ritual names, talismans, and lineages are enrollment technologies. 3) Inference: without 譜錄 alignment, personal cultivation lacks jurisdictional power. 4) Inference: the Jade Emperor / Primordial system is a constitution, not a poem. 5) Conclusion: hierarchy is the logic of efficacy—rank mediates what qi one may legally command.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi terms, treat 格局 and 调候 as “register status”: raw day-master strength is not rank until structured. 2) Cultivate through legitimate sequences (lineage, precepts, progressive practices) rather than scavenging techniques without enrollment logic. 3) Read 貴人、印星 as register-protectors; 空亡 on useful gods as missing paperwork. 4) For destiny work, clarify role identity (who you are authorized to be this 大運) before stacking methods.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike medical and lot texts, this is constitutional theology: it proves bureaucracy of heaven. Compared with 齋儀 texts that stage timebound rites, 譜錄 fixes permanent status. Compared with philosophical 文始/通玄 commentaries that dissolve name and rank into Dao, this text insists names and ranks are operationally real within the religious system.

entries.name_han: 洞玄靈寶八節齋宿啟儀
entries.logic_thesis: Cosmic joints (八節) are when heaven’s gates are procedurally open; therefore communal fasting and overnight preparatory liturgy (齋宿啟) can re-synchronize the human community with those gates. The text proves that calendar festivals are not commemorations but access protocols.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: the year has eight structural nodes of qi turn. 2) Inference: Lingbao zhai at those nodes multiplies efficacy through collective purity and correct sequence. 3) Inference: 宿啟 (night preparation/opening) is necessary because abrupt rite lacks accumulated stillness. 4) Inference: instrument, word, and time form a single machine. 5) Conclusion: salvation/communal blessing is scheduled engineering of purity at seasonal hinges.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Align personal cultivation intensives with 八節 and with BaZi 月令 transitions, not only with crises. 2) Practice “齋宿”: night-before preparation (sleep, diet, intention) before major decisions or rites. 3) Use group accountability (community zhai logic) when individual willpower fails in long 大運 repairs. 4) Map the eight nodes onto chart review cadence: structured re-synchronization eight times a year.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike private 服食 or 斷穀, this is collective and liturgical. Unlike 法師選擇記’s general hemerology, it fixes a specific Lingbao eight-joint template. Unlike 譜錄’s permanent ranks, it proves temporary, cyclical access. The argument is about synchronized opening, not personal hierarchy or secret calculation.

entries.logic_thesis: True response (靈應) is not arbitrary miracle but a lawful feedback when sincerity meets a codified lot corpus; therefore the “mystery-true” oracle proves that heaven answers in the language humans prepare. The text argues that responsiveness is co-authored by ritual form and querent integrity.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: unstructured prayer yields ambiguous outcomes. 2) Inference: a 寶籤 system pre-structures heaven’s reply into interpretable units. 3) Inference: 玄真 names the condition of non-counterfeit response—form without sincerity is empty, sincerity without form is mute. 4) Inference: repeated communal use calibrates the corpus’s practical reliability. 5) Conclusion: oracle efficacy proves a contract model of divine–human communication.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi counseling, pair chart facts with a sincerity check: clients who will not act convert any oracle into noise. 2) Prefer structured question forms (one issue, one horizon) analogous to single-lot draws. 3) Track “靈應” empirically: which advice types correlate with later outcomes for which 格局. 4) Use verse imagery to unlock emotional blocks that pure stem-branch talk cannot reach.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with named cult lots (聖母、洪恩、江東王), 《玄真靈應寶籤》 foregrounds the abstract principle of authentic response rather than a specialized protector’s portfolio. It differs from 四聖 by emphasizing 靈應 epistemology (how answerhood works) more than multi-saint patronage. Less bureaucratic than 譜錄, more theological than pure 選擇 notes.

entries.name_han: 大慈好生九天衛房聖母元君靈應寶籤
entries.logic_thesis: Birth, gestation, and the protection of life-gate (衛房) are under a specialized maternal jurisdiction in the nine heavens; therefore petitions about fertility, delivery, and child fate require a distinct oracle logic of compassion-for-life (好生). The text proves that not all lots are generic: domain-specific deities encode domain-specific causal priorities.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: human generation is cosmically vulnerable at the birth chamber. 2) Inference: 衛房聖母 specializes in that vulnerability. 3) Inference: lots under her warrant prioritize life-preservation ethics over career or war logics. 4) Inference: 好生 is not sentiment but a selection rule among possible outcomes. 5) Conclusion: specialized 靈籤 prove functional differentiation in the pantheon—jurisdiction determines judgment style.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, isolate 子女宮、時柱、印星、傷官 as “衛房” subsystem; do not judge them with pure wealth logic. 2) For fertility/child questions, weight compassion-preserving options (timing, medical care, rest) as first-order 用神 work. 3) When 七殺 or 羊刃 threatens body/children indicators, apply 好生 hierarchy: stabilize life before optimizing prestige. 4) Use maternal-deity logic to counsel without fatalism—protection is procedural, not guaranteed magic.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike general 四聖 or 玄真 lots, this corpus is domain-locked to natal protection. It differs from state-protection lots (護國、江東王) by private/family biopolitics rather than polity. Compared with medical 急救 texts, it externalizes protection to a celestial midwifery office rather than human emergency craft—same aim (life), different agent of proof.

entries.logic_thesis: Grace (洪恩) and efficacious rescue (靈濟) operate as a credit of past merit and present petition under the True Lords’ warrant; therefore misfortune is often framed as solvable debt rather than fixed doom. The text proves a soteriology of responsive aid: the lot system teaches how to re-enter a field of grace.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: the 靈濟真君 cult centers vast kindness and practical succor. 2) Inference: lots under this frame bias toward repentance, offering, and reopened paths. 3) Inference: reading misfortune as “blocked grace” changes agency from despair to repair. 4) Inference: standardized verses distribute that theology to ordinary querents. 5) Conclusion: the oracle proves pastoral logic—heaven’s help is structured as reclaimable relation.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When BaZi shows heavy 凶 but surviving 印/貴人, counsel “reclaim grace” strategies (repair relationships, clear obligations) over pure struggle. 2) Map 洪恩 to cumulative merit: consistent small correct actions in a hard 大運. 3) Use this lot’s mood for clients in shame-spirals: reframe as recoverable jurisdiction. 4) Pair chart 解災 with concrete restitution acts—grace logic hates empty performance.
entries.logic_compare: Distinct from 聖母’s natal specialty and from martial/state lots, 洪恩靈濟 emphasizes broad merciful rescue. Compared with 玄真’s abstract response theory, it personalizes response as “vast kindness.” Philosophically softer than 遁甲’s hard locks, it proves relational unlocking: not all closed gates are cryptographic—some are moral-relational.

entries.logic_thesis: “As-you-wish” (如意) under heaven-supporting sagehood is not unlimited desire fulfillment but alignment such that upright will and heavenly order coincide. The text proves that true wish-logic is rectification: when the wish is made compliant with 扶天, outcomes feel effortless because resistance was definitional, not external only.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: scattered desire collides with heaven’s order. 2) Inference: 廣聖 warrant disciplines wishes into supportable aims. 3) Inference: lots train the querent to detect which wishes are 扶天 and which are private inflation. 4) Inference: “如意” marks the coincidence event, not a vending machine. 5) Conclusion: oracle pedagogy is will-calibration under cosmic loyalty.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi goal-setting, filter aims through 格局: only wishes that the chart can “扶” without self-destruction count as 如意 candidates. 2) When 食傷 is strong, refine expression; when 財 is strong but 官印 broken, curb pure acquisition wishes. 3) Use lot-style questions: “Which of these two aims is heaven-supporting for this 大運?” 4) Measure success as reduced friction after alignment, not as raw intensity of craving satisfied.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 洪恩’s mercy-for-suffering emphasis, 扶天廣聖如意 stresses righteous wish alignment. Unlike 護國嘉濟’s territorial protection, it is more about personal will under cosmic loyalty. It sits between philosophy (will vs. Dao) and folk oracle, proving a middle thesis: desire is educable by sacred form.

entries.logic_thesis: Local tutelary sovereignty (江東王) links personal fortune to the health of a protected realm; therefore private lots under a state-guardian prove that micro-fate is nested in macro-political-spatial order. The text argues that “嘉濟” (excellent aid) flows through a territorial cult logic, not only through abstract heaven.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: regional deities govern and rescue within a jurisdiction. 2) Inference: petitions and lots under 江東王 inherit that territorial charter. 3) Inference: personal crises are readable as disturbances inside a larger protected order. 4) Inference: loyalty, offerings, and civic virtue modulate access to aid. 5) Conclusion: destiny is partly geopolitical-spiritual: place-based warrant differs from universal abstract Dao.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, weight 長生方向、驛馬、地理風水 as jurisdictional factors—not all remedies are portable across place. 2) For relocation advice, ask which “realm” will protect this day-master (cult logic → city/field choice). 3) Read 歲運 clashes with national/regional unrest years as 護國-layer context for individual charts. 4) Practice gratitude to place: stable base is a 貴人 often ignored by pure pillar math.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 九天聖母’s birth chamber or 四聖’s general ethics, this is territorial. Unlike Shangqing 譜錄’s celestial bureaucracy, the warrant is regional kingship. Compared with 遁甲’s abstract gates, 江東王 lots personalize space as a named protector. The unique proof is nested scale: person ⊂ realm ⊂ heaven.

entries.logic_thesis: If Dao were merely something of which we cannot speak, speech and Dao would be two; Guanyinzi’s formula “不可言即道” proves their non-duality—unspeakability is not a property attached to a mute object but the mode in which Dao is present. The commentary proves that linguistic failure is itself a positive revelation of unity, not a mere limit of humans.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: ordinary reading of Laozi makes “constant Dao” an unreachable other. 2) Inference: Guanyinzi flips: there is not a Dao that happens to be unspeakable; the unspeakable is Dao. 3) Inference: likewise for unthinkability—thought’s limit is not outside Dao. 4) Inference: tian/ming/shen/xuan are provisional names for one non-manipulable reality. 5) Conclusion: cultivation by forced speech-concepts self-defeats; release into the non-dual mode is the argument’s practical entailment.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi study, refuse idolatry of labels: 格局 names are tools, not the living chart—practice “unspeakable reading” after formal analysis. 2) When clients cling to fatal sentences (“I am 傷官架殺”), use 文始 logic to reopen non-dual agency. 3) Alternate technical drill with silent observation of timing as lived. 4) Treat 用神 selection as pointing, not capturing—like naming that must cancel itself.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 靈籤 corpora that multiply words as divine answers, 文始 notes prove the insufficiency and yet non-duality of words. Compared with 《文始真經言外旨》, a straight 注 stays closer to line-by-line ontological clarification. Compared with 通玄 commentaries on Wenzi, Guanyinzi’s line is more radically linguistic-mystical than political-ethical expansion of Laozi.

entries.logic_thesis: The surface of Guanyinzi still hides a further “aim beyond the words”; Chen Xianwei’s project proves that true commentary must invert and re-sound Laozi/Guanyinzi until the extra-linguistic intent appears. The text argues that orthodoxy is recovered by creative flipping (翻言), not by pedantic synonymy.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: scholars misread “非有道不可言” as allowing a speakable Dao. 2) Inference: only by flipping formulations does one recover Laozi’s “可道非常道.” 3) Inference: 言外旨 is a method—commentary as controlled paradox—not more doctrine piled on. 4) Inference: tian–ming–shen–xuan must be seen as one real, many names, available in each thing. 5) Conclusion: enlightenment is literacy of inversion: reading past the letter into the shared real.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Practice “翻言” on BaZi clichés: invert “財為養命之源” when 財 is the killer; seek the 言外 aim of the rule. 2) Teach advanced students dual reading: literal formula → inverted case → unified principle. 3) In cultivation, use paradox journaling: write the technique, then write its self-canceling version. 4) Judge methods by whether they return you to one real in ordinary affairs (物中知天), not by exoticism.
entries.logic_compare: It differs from ordinary 文始真經注 by explicit methodology of “beyond words” and Laozi-recovery via inversion. Unlike 通玄真經纘義/注, which elaborate Wenzi’s broader Daoist-political prose, 言外旨 remains a surgical mysticism of language and immediacy. It is more meta-hermeneutic than the base commentary: the proof is about how reading itself must convert.

entries.logic_thesis: Wenzi’s Tongxuan corpus extends Laozi into governance, mind, and nature as one fabric; 纘義 (continuing/splicing the meaning) proves that fidelity is productive elaboration—collecting and aligning meanings so the classic remains a living operating system for order. The argument is that Dao without applied structures of psyche and polity is an incomplete transmission.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Laozi’s brevity leaves application underspecified. 2) Inference: Wenzi elaborates Dao into human affairs without betraying non-action. 3) Inference: 纘義 work stitches later understanding back to that elaboration, preventing drift. 4) Inference: political and psychological counsel are tests of metaphysical claims. 5) Conclusion: true esotericism includes exoteric competence—order of self and realm as verification of 通玄.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Apply BaZi not only to private luck but to role ethics: how 官殺印食 prescribe modes of service and withdrawal. 2) Use Wenzi-style checks: does a reading increase clarity and humane order, or only anxiety? 3) Build “纘義” notebooks: splice classical rules with case outcomes to keep the art alive. 4) In years of strong 官運, practice non-coercive leadership (無為而治 as structure design, not laziness).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Guanyinzi commentaries that dissolve speech into mystical non-duality, 通玄纘義 proves constructive application. Compared with a plain 注, 纘義 emphasizes continuous meaning-gathering across generations. It is less ritual than Lingbao zhai, less oracular than 靈籤, more civic-philosophical: Dao as operable civilizational software.

entries.logic_thesis: Annotation of the Tongxuan (Wenzi) classic proves that Daoist truth is stable enough to be glossed line by line yet flexible enough to meet each age’s questions; the commentary form itself argues that authority is dialogical—classic and interpreter co-produce actionable sense. It demonstrates that “connecting the mysterious” (通玄) is clarification without profanation.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Wenzi speaks Laozi’s Dao into extended teachings. 2) Inference: without commentary, later readers lose operative sense. 3) Inference: a 注 maps obscure terms to practice and governance without reducing them to banality. 4) Inference: consistency across chapters reveals a single architecture of mind–nature–rule. 5) Conclusion: understanding is proven by coherent, usable gloss—not by silence alone or by endless novelty.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Maintain a personal “注” on your BaZi rules: define terms, edge cases, counterexamples. 2) When two classics conflict (e.g., fatal star vs. reformable 格局), write a reconciliatory gloss before advising. 3) Teach by annotation: students learn by glossing charts, not only memorizing slogans. 4) Schedule periodic re-annotation every 大運 shift—meaning must reconnect to new life conditions.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 《通玄真經纘義》, a 注 is tighter to the base text’s sequence; 纘義 is freer splicing of meaning. Compared with 《文始真經言外旨》, it is less paradox-driven and more expository. Against ritual and lot texts, it proves discursive reason as a path of 通玄: not selection of hours, not draw of slips, but sustained interpretive discipline.
